text:
harper: Quick follow-up from today's security all-hands  threading the leftover Qs on SOC2/ISO evidence bundles, KMS BYOK/HSM, and VPC flow logs.
noel: thanks. auditors specifically asked how we can prove "bundle integrity" after export. do we provide signed artifacts?
devika: yes  plan is a signed manifest next to each bundle with fields: bundle_id, requested_by, request_ticket, request_reason, timestamp, sha256, signer_id. Example (manifest.json):
```json
{
  "bundle_id": "bndl-2345678901-01",
  "requested_by": "noel",
  "request_ticket": "AUD-5601",
  "request_reason": "external ISO audit",
  "timestamp": "2026-11-12T16:45:01Z",
  "sha256": "<hex>",
  "signer_id": "redwood-svc-key-v4"
}
```
ryan: backend will sign the manifest and write it beside the bundle. we also write a separate provenance.txt that appends download events (principal, time, IP) so auditors can trace who touched the artifact.
legal-ops: Legal asks: include a human-readable "purpose" field and a short policy pointer in the manifest so auditors can see the authority. Also, any public retention statements require legal review.
harper: noted. can we make retention tiers concrete for the FAQ? auditors asked for numbers.
devika: proposal: default retention = 1y hot, 3y cold, archive option = 7y. Dedicated/reserved customers can request contract extensions up to 10y. I'll draft copy but will tag legal-ops before publishing.
noel: KMS BYOK question: do we support HSM-backed keys for Private deployments or just cloud KMS integrations? what does rotation history look like to customers?
ryan: we support cloud KMS today. HSM-backed BYOK will be offered as a pilot for regulated customers. For cloud KMS we return rotation timestamps and principal ids via control-plane API. For HSM BYOK we will include vendor attestation blobs in the evidence bundle and a normalized rotation_event record.
harper: action: pilot HSM BYOK for up to two customers in Q1 next year?
devika: sounds right. add a task to scope rotation attestation schema first.
infra-bot: Notice: evidence-exporter v2.6 deployed by ryan at 2345679000.
noel: VPC flow logs: customer asked whether they can stream flow logs into their SIEM with provenance preserved. what is the recommended setup?
ryan: recommended: export to customer-owned S3 or HTTPS endpoint. provide an IAM role for least privilege. include a manifest flag "replication_status" if cross-region replication is in play. sample CLI: ```redwood infra export-flow-logs --vpc vpc-0f1e2d --to s3://cust-logs/flow/ --role arn:aws:iam::222333444:role/RedwoodFlowExport```
legal-ops: also ensure export manifests include a pointer to the access-control decision (which role granted access) to satisfy auditors.
harper: good catch. owners and due dates so we can close this thread?
devika: owners: - Draft public-facing retention FAQ + legal review (owner: devika, due: 2026-12-01) - Implement signed manifest + provenance file (owner: ryan, due: 2026-12-08) - HSM BYOK attestation schema + pilot scope (owner: ryan + devika, due: 2027-02-15) - VPC flow log export cookbook + IAM templates (owner: noel, due: 2026-11-30) - Add bundle provenance card to console backlog (owner: infra, due: 2026-12-15)
noel: I'll draft the IAM examples and post to #eng-security later today.
harper: Thanks all  I'll post a one-page Confluence stub and tag reviewers when ready. If legal needs an early draft, tag legal-ops.
infra-bot: Reminder: create Jira ticket 'evidence-provenance' and link back to this thread.
ryan: :thumbsup:
